notes: Structured query templates for the Local SEO Audit, combining THREE Google sources: gmb (Google Business Profile), gsc (Search Console), ga4 (Analytics). Built against live schemas and validated. Field IDs are raw. Dates NOT stored — runtime resolves from today's date; compare_to_previous queries run twice (current + matching previous window). ACCOUNT ID SHAPES DIFFER: gmb = 'accountId-locationId'; gsc = site URL ('https://example.com/' or 'sc-domain:example.com'); ga4 = numeric property ID. GMB GROUP RULE (enforced by validate_query): search-impressions/search-terms metrics CANNOT combine with views/actions/reviews — they are separate queries. GMB monthly_search_impressions is monthly granularity; reviews totals are running snapshots. No ad spend in this audit (all organic/profile sources). Headline metric mapping: Profile Viewers=gmb views_total; Calls=gmb actions_phone; Impressions/Clicks=gsc impressions/clicks; Sessions/Engagement Rate=ga4 sessions/engagement_rate; Form Submissions/Key Events=ga4 key_events.

queries.title: Profile Views & Actions Totals
queries.note: Profile Viewers (views_total) + Calls (actions_phone) + website/directions/messages. Period totals; run twice for PoP.

queries.title: How Customers Find the Profile (view source)
queries.note: Maps vs Search, and discovery vs direct/branded. Single breakdown.

queries.title: Search Terms (how people search to find the profile)
queries.isolation_rule: search-impressions/search-terms group CANNOT combine with views/actions/reviews — keep separate.

queries.title: Reviews & Rating
queries.note: Running snapshot, not a period sum.

gsc.account_id_format: site URL, e.g. https://example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com

queries.title: Organic Search Totals
queries.note: Impressions & Clicks headline. Run twice for PoP.

queries.title: Top Search Queries
queries.note: Surface local-intent queries (city / 'near me' / service terms).

queries.title: Website Sessions, Engagement & Key Events
queries.note: Sessions, Engagement Rate, and Form Submissions (key_events). Run twice for PoP.

queries.title: Traffic by Channel
queries.note: Isolate Organic Search share and key events per channel.
